sections.heading: Variants
sections.text: Hast du Lust auf einen Kaffee? :: Do you fancy a coffee? Hast du Lust, ins Kino zu gehen? :: Do you feel like going to the cinema? Ich habe keine Lust. :: I don't feel like it.

sections.heading: Usage
sections.text: To invite a friend, or to say you don't want to. auf plus Akkusativ for a thing; zu plus infinitive for an activity.
